newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: TENNIS-KORDA GIVES CZECHS 1-0 LEAD OVER INDIA.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-KORDA GIVES CZECHS 1-0 LEAD OVER INDIA.

text.p: Czech number one Petr Korda overcame a spate of unforced errors to beat Mahesh Bhupathi and give the Czech Republic a 1-0 lead over India in their Davis Cup world group first round tie on Friday.
The veteran Korda, ranked more than 450 places higher than his opponent, showed few signs of trouble early in the match cruising to win the first set 6-3 in 29 minutes.
But a number of unforced errors allowed Bhupathi to stay in the second set, finally winning it 7-2 in a tie break.
Korda, ranked 33rd in the world, then put his game into high gear, taking the next two sets 6-1 6-2.
Jiri Novak and Leander Paes were playing in Friday's second singles match.
